messages:
Priya Singh: Hey team — my PR with the Python migration guide is blocked by docs CI, failing linkcheck + vale. Can someone take a quick look so we can merge before the customer demo tomorrow?
Sam Carter: link?
Priya Singh: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4287 — the failing jobs are linkcheck, vale, and markdownlint in the preview.
ci-bot: Automated checks summary for PR #4287: linkcheck: failed (1 broken external URL -> https://old.example.com/migrate), vale: failed (SBL000 passive-voice; "is recommended"), markdownlint: failed (MD013 line length in docs/migration/python.md: line 212), docs-preview: build failed (snippet render error: fenced code block has no language).
Marco Ruiz: For the vale hit, change "is recommended" -> "we recommend" or move to active voice: "We recommend upgrading to v2 to..." Small wording change.
Alice Chen: For linkcheck we can either update the external to the canonical upstream or replace with a relative anchor to our migration section. If it's a third-party blog that moved, use a Wayback link as a temporary fix.
Sam Carter: I can run linkcheck locally: `pre-commit run --all-files linkcheck` and grep the output. Want me to open a quick PR with link swap + code fence fix?
Priya Singh: That would be amazing — the only real blocker is the external link and the missing code language on the snippet around the KV cache example.
Alice Chen: I'll push a tiny commit: add language to the fence (```python) and swap the broken URL to https://web.archive.org/web/20210801/https://old.example.com/migrate for now. Also wrap long lines around 80 cols to satisfy MD013.
Marco Ruiz: After those fixes we should still run vale locally `vale docs/ --minAlertLevel suggestion` — there might be other passive constructions. But this PR looks small, so we can address anything non-blocking in a follow-up.
docs-bot: Reminder: if changes are only lint fixes, assign `docs:quick-merge` label and request approvals from any docs approver.
Sam Carter: I'll queue the patch and trigger CI. If it turns green, want to fast-track? Priya, is this considered customer-critical for tomorrow?
Priya Singh: Yes — demo tomorrow morning. Would appreciate fast-track.
Alice Chen: If CI passes, add `docs-urgent` label and @-mention the docs approvers group. I'll nominate @Marco for a quick review.
Marco Ruiz: Happy to do a rapid review once CI is green. If green, please use "Squash and merge" with the commit message: "fix(docs): quick lint/link fixes for python migration guide".
Priya Singh: Thanks all — pinging approvers after CI completes. If anything else fails I'll post the smaller diffs here.
Sam Carter: CI passed on my branch run, pushing PR update now.
ci-bot: linkcheck: passed; markdownlint: passed; vale: passed; docs-preview: success — preview available at https://preview.redwood.ai/docs/pr-4287
Priya Singh: Awesome — tagging approvers now. @docs-approvers please review/merge when you can.
Alice Chen: LGTM from me.
Marco Ruiz: Quick pass done, looks good. Go ahead.
Priya Singh: Merged. Thanks everyone for the quick turnaround — will monitor the demo and report back if anything pops up.
